card.name: Words just before "any" in prohibitions
card.fires_on: The word right before "any" (or "any form/manner/way") in restriction phrases. Typical settings are copyright notices and "do not cut or alter ... in any way".

modes.label: Copyright restrictions
modes.description: Wording before "any form/manner" in rights notices about reproducing or using material.
modes.example: All rights reserved including the right of reproduction in whole or in part<< in>> any form.

modes.label: The phrase "do not alter in any way"
modes.description: Instructions not to cut, modify or alter a product, where "in" comes just before "any way".
modes.example: Do not cut or alter the patch<< in>> any way. (2.1)

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "any" (and Chinese equivalents) as the next word.
card.plain: It responds to the word just before "any" in phrases like "in any way" or "in any form".
